findings: The candidate preserves the recovered source contract: a file-backed collection of N numbers and a request for the largest 10 values.
Number type, UTF-8 line format, duplicate multiplicity, malformed-row handling and N < 10 behavior are explicitly labelled as candidate API choices rather than recovered source facts.
The prefix invariant is sufficient: after each input value, the min-heap contains the largest min(K, i) values from the processed prefix, with the weakest retained candidate at the root.
The implementation performs one sequential file scan and retains at most K numeric candidates; the stated O(N log K) time and O(K) candidate-state bounds match the implementation.

Seven fixed boundary families and 5000 deterministic randomized files are checked against a structurally different full-sort-prefix oracle, including duplicates, negative values and signed-long extremes.
The candidate keeps distinct-value Top-K as a separate policy and does not silently reinterpret the source question.
The answer does not fabricate a production incident, data volume, online-judge identity or hidden source constraint.
Human approval remains a separate pilot promotion gate.
